title: Canonical pullback comparisons intertwine coefficient-map iterates
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $h:W\to X$ a morphism of schemes, and $t:X\to X$, $t_W:W\to W$ endomorphisms with $ht_W=th$. Use ordinary derived categories of constant $A$-module sheaves on the small pro-etale sites, with exact inverse images $Lf^*=f^{-1}$ as in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Let $P_m=L(t^m)^*$ and $Q_m=L(t_W^m)^*$ for $m\geq0$, using the identity comparisons at $m=0$. Let $d^X_m:P_{m+1}\xrightarrow{\sim}P_1P_m$ and $d^W_m:Q_{m+1}\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_1Q_m$ be the canonical pullback-composition comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition]. Write $c_m:Q_mLh^*\xrightarrow{\sim}Lh^*P_m$ for the comparison obtained from $ht_W^m=t^mh$. For every derived complex $K$, these canonical comparisons satisfy
$$Lh^*(d^X_{m,K})\circ c_{m+1,K}=c_{1,P_mK}\circ Q_1(c_{m,K})\circ d^W_{m,Lh^*K}\quad(m\geq0).$$
For any morphism $u:P_1K\to K$, define $u_1=u$ and $u_{m+1}=u\circ P_1(u_m)\circ d^X_{m,K}$. Put $v=Lh^*(u)\circ c_{1,K}$ and define $v_m$ by the same recursion with $Q_m,d^W_m$. Then
$$v_m=Lh^*(u_m)\circ c_{m,K}\quad(m\geq1).$$
No invertibility, finite-type or Cartesian-square hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Prove the commuting-power equation by induction. At zero use identity laws. For m+1 expand both powers by pow_succ, reassociate, apply the induction hypothesis and then the original commuting square.

Use the existing normalized derived pullback associativity theorem for the triples (h,t,t^m), (tW,h,t^m), and (tW,tW^m,h). Equality induction gives compatibility of each binary comparison with transport of either scheme morphism. Expand the square and power-step comparisons; precompose with the inverse comparison for (tW^(m+1),h). Move the power transports through the binary comparisons, apply the three associativity equalities, use the commuting-power equation and the original square, and cancel the inverse comparisons. All remaining transports compose to the same scheme-morphism equality, so proof irrelevance identifies them. This works for m=0 without requiring separate unit comparisons.

Induct on the positive coefficient-iterate index n. For n=0 reduce t^1=t and the associated equality transports; the result is the defining restricted coefficient map. For the successor expand both recursive definitions, substitute the induction hypothesis, and use naturality of the square comparison for (tW,h,t) at the preceding coefficient iterate. Apply the comparison identity from the previous step and functoriality of h-pullback to obtain the next iterate. No coefficient morphism is inverted.
